problem: A whole-query No cannot identify which clause fails; language factorization alone does not supply missing supervision.
hypothesis: Only some available query pairs may provide a controlled predicate contrast or subset/conjunction comparison on the identical visual observation.
intervention: Use the two fixed teacher text interpretations and DESIGN own answers; enumerate exact image/context matched query contrasts without learning atom targets.
fixed_controls: Hold rendered visual digest, ID, frame, actual view, bbox, residual prompt, and all accepted nonchanged clauses fixed.
measurements: Report available query relationships, actually observed matched pairs, raw teacher contrast magnitude, and conjunction/subset monotonicity residuals.
no_semantic_truth_claim: Text consensus and teacher probabilities can both be wrong; violations are not target error labels, and matching does not prove factor identifiability.
fairness: Any later full and ordinary KD receive the same language structures, paid answers and visual features.
reason_for_new_dependency: V1 text parser failed format gate before the dependent audit read any image answers; v2 changes only language instructions and cost persistence.
dependency_repair: Both free-form text versions failed strict format gates; v3 uses constrained generation. Identical visual/context matching and no pseudo-atom target creation remain unchanged.
